item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Sisi used historical grievance, misinformation, or fabricated external threats to build public support for a conflict. I also did not find a 2024 case where he used a false intelligence claim to justify a major war or cross-border campaign. The public record I found is mostly de-escalatory on Gaza and repressive on domestic dissent. So the best-supported reading is: truthful public explanation on the external-security question, but manipulative coercion in the domestic-security context.","evidence":[{"title":"President El-Sisi and Jordan’s King Abdullah II Hold Talks in Amman","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic of Egypt","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/new142024-2/","summary":"Sisi publicly said Rafah military action would have grave consequences and backed an immediate ceasefire.
